description: Source code for QuicHeadersStream class implementing HTTP/3 header stream handling in QUIC protocol.

classes.name: QuicHeadersStream
classes.description: Handles HTTP/3 header stream in QUIC, managing header data, acknowledgments, retransmissions, and stream resets.

methods.name: OnDataAvailable
methods.description: Processes available header data from the stream.

methods.name: MaybeReleaseSequencerBuffer
methods.description: Releases the sequencer buffer if appropriate.

methods.name: OnStreamFrameAcked
methods.description: Handles acknowledgment of stream frames, updating header state and invoking acknowledgment listeners.

methods.name: OnStreamFrameRetransmitted
methods.description: Handles retransmission of stream frames, notifying acknowledgment listeners.

methods.name: OnDataBuffered
methods.description: Buffers header data that has been sent but not yet acknowledged.
